### `class DebugCommand` — `fabric/src/main/java/villager_voices/fabric/debug/DebugCommand.java`
Development-only: /villager_voices debug (docs/spec/operations/testing.md's "Development tool" row, VV-13) -- genuinely useful here since several of the 16 VillagerReactionEvents (raid, zombification, breeding) are slow or awkward to trigger manually while testing.
- `void register()`
- `int trigger(CommandSourceStack source, VillagerReactionEvent event, Villager villager)` — Forces event on villager: real selection and display, cooldowns bypassed (VillagerEventBus#publishBypassingRules).
- `int lines(CommandSourceStack source, VillagerReactionEvent event)` — Prints every line the currently-loaded catalogue holds for event, in catalogue order.
- `int events(CommandSourceStack source)` — Lists all 16 event ids this command (and the catalogue's per-event JSON files) accept.
